reason: Table I identifies the overall patient-versus-control comparison for ApaLI allele frequencies and prints final mutually exclusive groups of 93 patients and 74 controls. These establish participant N. Subgroups, allele categories, genotype categories, and family-linkage samples are not added to these participant counts. Controls with first-degree relatives with schizophrenia were excluded. One pedigree supplied no patient because all patients diagnosed with schizophrenia had deceased. The final patient sample includes one randomly chosen patient from each of the other pedigrees. No additional target-table exclusions are reported.
